pr.title: fix(audit): tokenless channel reads, ledgered token failure, Nexus answer note, README corrections
pr.body:
Fixes from the 2026-11-12 full-stack audit (owner order: "Fix all send pr to muse u merge he deploys"). Findings: #235 comment 6811710254.

## Changes
- **`src/lib/channelCalls.ts`**: without a token the channel read takes the first and the newest page only. A tokenless load read all 12 pages of the 60/hour anonymous quota and the next load was HTTP 403.
- **`src/App.tsx`**: the missing-GitHub-token reply now names the free model, `/sculpt` and `/patch`, and is recorded in the failure ledger (it was in the log only).
- **`src/lib/ai/providerRouter.ts`**: every plain-text Nexus answer carries a standing note that the checkpoint is a tool-call specialist. The segment stays verbatim. The Nexus task frame (`buildNexusToolInput`) is untouched.
- **`README.md`**: provider table (Nexus Intelligence, Muse · Meta), tech stack (Playwright, SQLite), NEXUS tab visibility, failure view, audit notes with run history.

## Not changed, by design
- `extractImagePrompt` keeps the full sentence: that is tested behaviour.
- The NEXUS counts on a fresh browser come from the published `nexus-intake-data` branch.

## Tested
- Full gate before the rebase: vitest 2699 passed / 8 skipped, eslint 0 errors (2 existing warnings), `npm run build` ok.
- After the rebase onto `e4e683b5`: `tsc -b` clean; `src/lib/ai` + `channelCalls.test.ts` 180 passed / 2 skipped; eslint clean on touched files.
- New tests: tokenless read fetches pages `[1, 12]` only, a token still walks back; the Nexus text answer equals segment + note.

## Not verified
- The deployed app (needs the Pages deploy).
- No protected path is touched.
